iron_plate.description: A standard metal plate made from forged iron that forms the base's basic skeleton and durable armor layers.

copper_wire.description: A thin and flexible copper wire used for electrical conduction. A critical component for communication systems and energy distribution.

aluminum_profile.description: A profile made from lightweight and durable aluminum used to create structural support and frames. Especially preferred in aircraft and vehicle construction.

titanium_bar.description: A strong metal bar made from titanium with high strength and corrosion resistance, used in armor and structural components.

silicon_crystal.description: A critical component for electronic circuits and solar panels, produced from silicon with semiconductor properties.

carbon_fiber.description: An advanced material with high strength and low weight, used in armor and structural components.

chromium_coating.description: A surface treatment used to increase durability and provide protection against corrosion. Generally used in armor and vehicle parts.
